description: Complete rewrite of all CRM pages (Leads, Deals, Customers, Activities) replacing ALL mock data with real Supabase hooks, plus create two new pages (FollowUps and ConversionFunnel). All pages follow the dark spatial glassmorphism design system.
steps: REWRITE src/pages/crm/Leads.tsx: Remove ALL mockLeads array and local Lead interface. Wire to useLeads() + useLeadsByStage() from hooks. Implement Kanban board view with columns per status (new, contacted, qualified, proposal, negotiation, won, lost) using state-based drag simulation (onDragStart/onDragOver/onDrop or click-to-move with useUpdateLeadStatus mutation). Each lead card shows: company, contact name, score badge (circular, green>70/yellow 40-70/red<40), estimated_value formatted, next follow-up date if available, assigned avatar initials. Add lead detail Sheet (side panel) on card click with: full lead info, score breakdown horizontal bar, activity timeline (using useActivities({lead_id})), status change buttons, Convert to Customer button (visible for qualified/proposal/negotiation/won status using useConvertLead mutation), Convert to Deal button. Add filters bar: status dropdown, source dropdown, assigned_to, score range. Keep Kanban + table view toggle. Add Lead dialog should use useCreateLead mutation with react-hook-form + zod validation. Show toast on all mutations (success/error) via sonner.

REWRITE src/pages/crm/Deals.tsx: Remove ALL mockDeals array and local Deal interface. Wire to useDeals() + useDealsByStage(). Pipeline Kanban view + table view toggle. Deal cards show: title, company (from customer if linked), value formatted with $, probability %, expected close date, stage badge with colored borders. Add deal detail Sheet with: full deal info, linked lead info (if converted_from_lead_id), linked customer, stage progression stepper (visual steps showing current stage highlighted), weighted value display (value x probability), activity timeline, Close Won / Close Lost buttons (using useCloseDeal), Create Sales Order button when stage is closed_won (using useConvertDealToOrder). Pipeline value summary bar at top: show total value per stage with emerald gradient fill bars and weighted total. Filters: stage, assigned_to, value range, close date range. Add Deal dialog uses useCreateDeal with form validation. Toast notifications on all mutations.

ENHANCE src/pages/crm/Customers.tsx: Remove mockCustomers array. Wire to real useCustomers() hook. Keep the DataTable with tabs for type filtering. Add customer detail Sheet on row click with: full customer info (name, email, phone, company, type, address), total lifetime value (total_spent), total orders count (total_orders), deal history section (useDeals({customer_id})), activity timeline (useActivities({customer_id})), is_active badge. Keep the Add Customer dialog but wire to useCreateCustomer mutation with react-hook-form + zod. Toast notifications.

REWRITE src/pages/crm/Activities.tsx: Remove ALL mockActivities array. Wire to useActivityFeed() + useTodayActivities(). Split layout: Left panel 'Today's Tasks' (activities scheduled today, checkbox to complete via useCompleteActivity, overdue items styled in red, grouped by related entity), Right panel 'Activity Feed' (infinite-scroll-style paginated timeline using useActivityFeed with load-more button, each item shows type icon with colored circle, title, description truncated, entity link text, timestamp, assigned user). Add quick-add activity floating action button (bottom-right) opening a Dialog with type, title, description, related entity selector, scheduled_at, using useCreateActivity mutation. Filters: activity_type, entity type, date range, completed/pending toggle. When completing an activity show a toast 'Schedule follow-up?' with action button that opens follow-up scheduler inline.

CREATE src/pages/crm/FollowUps.tsx: New follow-up management dashboard page. Sections: Overdue (red-tinted cards), Due Today (amber-tinted), Upcoming This Week, Later. Each follow-up card shows: title, related entity link text, assigned user, due date formatted, snooze button (calls useSnoozeFollowUp with +1/+3/+7 day options dropdown), complete button (useCompleteActivity). Collapsible 'Automation Rules' section: list followup_rules from useFollowUpRules() with Switch toggle to enable/disable each rule (useToggleRule), show rule name and a brief human-readable description of trigger + action. Stats header: total follow-ups count, overdue count (red if > 5), completion rate percentage. Use motion/react for animations, glass card styling, PageHeader component.

CREATE src/pages/crm/ConversionFunnel.tsx: Visual conversion funnel page. Use Recharts FunnelChart or stacked BarChart to show: Leads count -> Qualified count -> Proposal count -> Won count -> Customer count (data from useLeadsByStage). Show conversion rate percentages between stages. Average time in each stage (calculated from leads data if possible, or show placeholder). Win rate: won/(won+lost) percentage. Lead source effectiveness section: bar chart showing conversion rates per source. Monthly trends: simple area chart of leads created vs converted per month (from leads created_at). Hot leads section at bottom: list leads with score > 70 from useHotLeads() with Convert button. Use emerald-to-teal gradient for funnel visualization. All data from real hooks.
acceptance_criteria: src/pages/crm/Leads.tsx has ZERO mock data arrays, uses useLeads/useLeadsByStage/useUpdateLeadStatus/useCreateLead/useConvertLead hooks
src/pages/crm/Deals.tsx has ZERO mock data arrays, uses useDeals/useDealsByStage/useCreateDeal/useCloseDeal/useAdvanceDeal hooks
src/pages/crm/Customers.tsx has ZERO mock data arrays, uses useCustomers/useCreateCustomer hooks with detail sheet
src/pages/crm/Activities.tsx has ZERO mock data arrays, uses useActivityFeed/useTodayActivities/useCreateActivity/useCompleteActivity hooks
src/pages/crm/FollowUps.tsx exists as new page with sections: Overdue, Due Today, Upcoming, Later, and Automation Rules
src/pages/crm/ConversionFunnel.tsx exists as new page with funnel visualization using Recharts and real hook data
All pages use sonner toast() for mutation feedback (success, error, info, warning)
All pages follow dark glassmorphism design: glass cards, colored borders, emerald primary, motion animations
Loading skeletons shown during data fetches (using Skeleton component or LoadingSkeleton)
Empty states shown when no data available
bun run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
verification: Run 'cd /projects/sandbox/stockflow-inventory-crm && bun run build' and confirm successful build with no TypeScript errors
